fit.why: The Security Service of Ukraine's own video of its strike on the Kerch bridge, released 17 Nov: a thermal drone approach to the arch (0.17 to 22.99 s), the impact at night (22.99 to 26.99 s), the arch down in daylight (26.99 s on). The span starts after the 0.17 s title card ('fourth SSU strike') and stops at 28.8 s, before the SSU's end card wipes in (between 28.8 and 29.4 s). Party label RELEASED BY THE SECURITY SERVICE OF UKRAINE; the SSU's own bug sits top left.

The Kremlin's own record of Putin's news conference in Shenzhen on 19 Nov (a news conference by the page's own title). The page's contents put 'The attacks on the Crimean Bridge' at 22:45 to 25:40; sampled frames show the question from the floor at about 22:46 and Putin answering at the lectern from about 23:00 to 25:35. The span is that answer; the bite is cut inside it at sentence bounds at the transcript step. Party label RELEASED BY THE KREMLIN.

The Kremlin's English transcript of the 19 Nov news conference: Putin says the Crimean Bridge is a civilian facility and that 'following the strikes on the Crimean Bridge, there will be no negotiations'. The reader speaks it as TRANSLATION · KREMLIN TRANSCRIPT.
